summary: First-iteration end-to-end review of SecureLend (NBFC + Hybrid IDS). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass covering health, admin+user auth, /auth/me, SQLi block, unauthorized admin (403), brute-force lockout (429 + IP block + unblock), OTP send/verify, registration (invalid PAN rejected 422), bank consent gating, loan apply with 5 explainable factors, admin stats/attacks/blocked-ips/users/loans, demo attack simulator for all 6 kinds, admin loan override. Frontend: Landing, admin dashboard (stats + 6 tabs + 6 demo cards + attack trigger toast), user dashboard, bank connect + consent modal, loan apply with explainable factor breakdown — all working.

minor.issue: Response omits `decision` key (only `loan_status` is returned). Frontend LoanApply.jsx line 152 checks `result.decision !== 'Approved'` — always true → 'suggested amount' hint is shown even for Approved loans. Either add `decision` to loan_doc or change frontend to check `loan_status`.

ui_bugs.issue: Suggested-amount hint appears even when status=Approved (see backend minor issue above). Change condition to `result.loan_status !== 'Approved'`.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings while tab is hidden — cosmetic console noise only; charts render fine when Overview tab is active.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In backend server.py `loans_apply`, add `"decision": result["decision"]` to loan_doc so the frontend's suggested-amount hint condition works. Alternatively, change LoanApply.jsx line 152 to use `loan_status`.
OPTIONAL: In Overview tab, wrap Recharts containers so they only mount when tab active (removes -1/-1 warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: IDS middleware buffers full request body in memory — fine for JSON but risks large multipart uploads; upload path currently only used by KYC endpoint (5MB cap) so acceptable.
JWT_SECRET is checked-in (backend/.env). Fine for demo but flag for prod deployment.
auth.py extracts token from cookie OR Authorization header (correct); `_set_cookies` uses secure=True + samesite=none which is required for cross-origin preview deployment (works over HTTPS).
seed_admin correctly re-hashes password if env value changes (idempotent).
IsolationForest anomaly gated by `count < 15` — good, prevents false positives on cold start.
Bank connect deletes existing bank_verifications before inserting — expected but user tests can lose data if run concurrently; acceptable for demo.
server.py is 683 lines — near threshold, consider splitting admin & user routers into modules if further features are added.
test_credentials: Admin admin@securelend.io / Admin@1234 · Demo user rahul.sharma@example.com / Demo@1234 (verified via /app/memory/test_credentials.md and backend .env)
seed_data_creation: None manually created — relied on backend startup seed (admin + 10 demo users + 8 loans + 50 attack logs + 3 blocked IPs). Backend tests created ~1 additional TEST_ user during registration test (cleanup not implemented for that single doc; acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests run in parallel via pytest-xdist (loadscope, 2 workers per pytest.ini). The brute-force test blocks the shared egress IP, which cascades to other tests on the second worker. conftest.py mitigates this by auto-unblocking all IPs before each test AND transparently retrying any requests-library call that hits a 403 'IP is temporarily blocked'. Do NOT remove this helper. If a later test times out unexpectedly, run `python -c 'from pymongo import MongoClient; import os; from datetime import datetime, timezone; MongoClient(os.environ["MONGO_URL"])[os.environ["DB_NAME"]].blocked_ips.update_many({"unblocked_at": None}, {"$set": {"unblocked_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}})'` first to clear blocked IPs.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Only cosmetic mismatch: backend returns `loan_status` but not `decision`; frontend LoanApply uses `result.decision` which is undefined, causing a benign 'suggested amount' hint to appear on Approved loans. Fix in either place (see action_items).
